references.text: Describes how the fat from the sin offering is to be burned on the altar, which is the same practice performed in Leviticus 16:25
The priest shall burn all the fat on the altar, just like the fat from the peace offering - parallel instruction regarding burning of fat from the sin offering
All the fat shall be removed and burned on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the Lord - same practice with the fat of the sin offering
The fat shall be burned on the altar together with the Lord's food offering - identical action with the fat of the sin offering
Basic instructions about which parts of the fat are to be burned on the altar as a food offering to the Lord
The priest shall burn the fat on the altar - general rule for offerings that also applies to the sin offering on the Day of Atonement
The fat covering the entrails shall be burned on the altar - early regulation concerning burning of fat in sacrifices
